title: Wikipedia: known misspellings
description: Searches English Wikipedia for GGCMS's known misspellings, ten articles per misspelling per visit, then moves to the next; when every one has had its visit it starts again a page deeper. Links, file names, addresses, references and templates are skipped by rule, and a local model judges the rest in their sentences. Each typo is dated by WikiWho, which knows the edit that brought every word into an article, so long-standing ones come first and minutes-old ones are held back. Typos go to a results file, and to the App Hub's Social page, for a person to confirm and fix by hand; it never edits Wikipedia. A doubled-<pair> target hunts the doubled-letter worker's new slips instead, as a test of them: its .pairs.txt says which turn up in real writing and which are real words.
